finalText:
All 40 tests pass now.

**Bug:** `computeTotal` in `src/pricing/engine.js` rounded to 2 decimal places in USD after each coupon step, then rounded again after converting to the target currency. Percent discounts (e.g. 10% off) routinely produce sub-cent fractions; rounding those away in USD *before* conversion, then applying an exchange rate, could tip the final amount across a rounding boundary — landing a cent (or yen) short in GBP, CAD, or JPY. Flat discounts and USD orders never triggered it, which is why the failures looked sporadic. Fixed by rounding only once, on the final converted total.
